segments.name: drug products
segments.description: Develops and commercializes drug products, chiefly Annamycin, a next-generation anthracycline for relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia.
segments.evidence: Management has determined that the Company operates in one reportable segment, which is the development and commercialization of drug products.

revenueModel.text: The company has generated no revenue and relies on outside financing, such as equity and debt offerings, to fund its operations.
revenueModel.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the Company had an accumulated deficit of $ 206.0 million since inception and had not yet generated any revenues from operations.
